Three-dimensional (3D) whole-brain high-resolution T1-weighted (1 mm 3 ) images

All MRI data were obtained using a 3.0-T scanner (MAGNETOM® Trio Tim System; Siemens Medical Solutions, Erlangen, Germany) using a standard 8-channel head coil receiver at the Magnetic Resonance Center of Beijing Chao-Yang Hospital.

Three-dimensional (3D) whole-brain high-resolution T1-weighted (1 mm 3 ) images were acquired using the following parameters: repetition time = 1900 ms; echo time = 2.52 ms; flip angle = 9°; total slices = 176; slice thickness = 1 mm; matrix = 250 × 250; in-plane voxel size = 1 × 1 × 1 mm 3 ; and total acquisition time= 5:40 min.
